headline: Quiet day as earlier stories begin to fade
body: A quiet day with no scored events. For the first time in this period, older announcements began to fade: Gatekeeper and Reversion each slipped by 0.01 as their earlier boosts wore off, and the world factors drifted by similarly tiny amounts. Horizon Balance holds at +1.97.
movers_note: Only fading moved the board: Gatekeeper and Reversion each -0.01, both rounding to 0.0.
